source_title: 아이러니하게도 도적이 진짜 제일 착함 ㅋㅋ
subtitle: 혐오 밈과 정반대인 인던 최고의 모범 파티원 도적

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
도적이 입구에 먼저 왔네?
소문처럼 띠껍지 않나?
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle dungeon entrance arrival shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the left, skeptical Orc Warrior protection tank (fair peach skin (never green skin), green plush orc hood with TWO curved ivory horns, jet-black ponytail, ONLY 1H sword and sturdy steel kite shield (zero extra battle axe!) stowed neatly on back) approaches squinting suspiciously with one raised eyebrow. On the right, cheerful Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, EXACTLY TWO twin green daggers sheathed at waist) waits neatly by the entrance waving warmly with an empty welcoming hand and bright smiling blue eyes.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
잠긴 상자 먼저 따놨어요!
공평하게 주사위 굴리실래요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile wholesome dungeon loot shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the left, polite Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, EXACTLY TWO twin green daggers sheathed at waist) kneels beside an unlocked glowing wooden treasure chest offering a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold loot die cube with round dot pips only (zero digits) in her open palm with a sweet gentle smile. On the right, touched Troll Shaman (wooden totem staff stowed on back) stares with sparkling awestruck emerald eyes clasping both empty hands to her cheeks.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
엑스 찍자마자 칼혼절?!
시키지도 않았는데 미쳤네!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle dungeon pull shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch, wide open pure #FFFFFF upper-right space, and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the left, amazed Orc Warrior protection tank (fair peach skin (never green skin), green plush orc hood with TWO curved ivory horns, jet-black ponytail, wielding ONLY 1H sword and sturdy steel kite shield with outer armored shield face facing enemy, zero extra battle axe!) glances ahead in stunned admiration. On the lower-right, swift Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, EXACTLY TWO twin green daggers sheathed at waist) gives a crisp empty-hand thumbs-up beside a dizzy stunned cute 2.5-head chibi SD armored dungeon ogre mob wearing a glowing red X-mark overhead and spinning stun stars.
